hero.sub: The National Congress of Political Marketing lands in {city}. {dateLong}. Strategy, narrative and intelligence for those who do politics seriously.

tour.lead: For the first time, the CNMP becomes an international tour. Three stops, three countries, a single community that is redefining how politics is done in the region.

speakers.lead: Strategists, consultants and analysts from across the region. Some already confirmed, others we will reveal in the coming weeks.

audience.lead: This congress is not for the curious or for spectators. It is for those who know that politics has changed — and want to change with it.
audience.1: You are a candidate in an election and you need a winning narrative.
audience.2: You are a consultant, strategist or campaign manager and you want to be at the level of the best.
audience.3: You are a political communicator, journalist or government advisor seeking to master persuasion.
audience.4: You are a student of political science, communication or marketing and you want to connect with the real world.
audience.5: You are part of a government team and you want to communicate well what you do.
audience.6: Or you simply are not afraid of power, but of not knowing how to use it.

testimonials.quote1: The level of the speakers and the quality of the networking is unlike any other political event in the region.
testimonials.quote2: I left with a complete strategy for my campaign. Every panel was straight to the point, no filler.
testimonials.quote3: I met the right people. The CNMP is where the alliances that decide elections are built.

allies.lead: Connect with a community of 500+ leaders from the electoral world, a political decision-making ecosystem in LATAM and visibility to millions on social media.

cta.text: Secure your place at the next stop of the tour. Limited spots per city, independent ticketing.

organizacion.bio1: Manager, strategist and political consultant with more than 10 years of experience directing electoral campaigns, training and preparing candidates, creating political strategy and advising governments on public communication.
organizacion.bio2: His success rate places him as one of the most effective strategists of disruptive communication in conventional and digital media.
organizacion.achievement1: Creator and organizer of the National Congress of Political Marketing (Colombia).
organizacion.achievement2: Founder of the National Association of Political Consultants ASOCOPOL
organizacion.achievement3: Decorated with the María Manuela Beltrán medal, awarded for excellence, by the municipality of El Socorro, Santander.
organizacion.achievement4: Recognized as the youngest councilman in Colombia (2016).

footer2.quote: "A correct strategy can survive a mediocre campaign, but even a brilliant campaign can fail if the strategy is wrong"
